_readme: Hand-curated overlay on the machine-generated schemas.json (BACKLOG: ICS forms Phase 3).
Per form (key = schemas.json key), per AcroForm field name:
label    — human-readable label shown in the form editor (overrides the scraped /TU label)
guidance — what belongs in this field; included verbatim in the AI fill prompt
ai_fill  — true when the fill LLM should attempt to populate this field. Fields that
require a human decision (signatures, attachment checkboxes, page numbers)
stay false and are left for the editor.
Merged into load_schemas() output by incidents/pdf_filler.py, so the /api/ics-forms/schemas
endpoint and the fill prompt both read from this single source of truth.

1 Incident Name_5.label: 1. Incident Name
1 Incident Name_5.guidance: Short incident name, max ~35 characters (single-line box): address or landmark plus incident type, e.g. 'Maple St Structure Fire'.

Date From.label: 2. Operational Period — Date From
Date From.guidance: Start date of this operational period. Use the incident start date (current date if the transcript gives no other).

Date To.label: 2. Operational Period — Date To
Date To.guidance: End date of this operational period. Leave blank if not established.

Time From.label: 2. Operational Period — Time From
Time From.guidance: Start time (24h) of this operational period. Use the incident start time if stated.

Time To.label: 2. Operational Period — Time To
Time To.guidance: End time (24h) of this operational period. Leave blank if not established.

3 Objectives.label: 3. Objective(s)
3 Objectives.guidance: Numbered incident objectives for this operational period, ordered life safety first, then incident stabilization, then property conservation. Ground each objective in the scene conditions; keep them specific and achievable (e.g. '1. Confirm primary search complete in exposure Bravo. 2. Contain fire to building of origin.').

4 Operational Period Command Emphasis.label: 4. Operational Period Command Emphasis
4 Operational Period Command Emphasis.guidance: The commander's key emphasis for the period: the dominant safety concern or tactical priority (e.g. 'Defensive operations only — no interior attack; maintain collapse zones.').

General Situational Awareness.label: 4a. General Situational Awareness
General Situational Awareness.guidance: Situational factors all personnel must know: weather, hazards, access constraints, utilities status. Only include what the evidence supports.

Yes.label: 5. Site Safety Plan Required — Yes
Yes.guidance: Check when a site safety plan is required (hazmat, structural collapse risk, or any scene with red/unsafe conditions). Exactly one of Yes/No should be checked.

No.label: 5. Site Safety Plan Required — No
No.guidance: Check when no site safety plan is required. Exactly one of Yes/No should be checked.

5 Site Safety Plan Required Yes No Appro.label: 5a. Approved Site Safety Plan(s) Located At
5 Site Safety Plan Required Yes No Appro.guidance: Location of the approved site safety plan documents. Fill only if stated; otherwise leave blank.

ICS 203.label: 6. IAP Attachment — ICS 203 Organization Assignment List

ICS 205.label: 6. IAP Attachment — ICS 205 Radio Communications Plan

ICS 207.label: 6. IAP Attachment — ICS 207 Incident Organization Chart

7 Prepared by Name.label: 7. Prepared By — Name
7 Prepared by Name.guidance: Name of the person preparing this form. Fill only if a name is explicitly stated in the evidence; never invent one.

PositionTitle_5.label: 7. Prepared By — Position/Title
PositionTitle_5.guidance: ICS position of the preparer. For this form, 'Planning Section Chief' or 'Incident Commander' as the evidence supports.

8 Approved by Incident Commander Name.label: 8. Approved By Incident Commander — Name
8 Approved by Incident Commander Name.guidance: Name of the approving Incident Commander. Fill only if explicitly stated; never invent one.

DateTime_5.label: Date/Time Prepared
DateTime_5.guidance: Date and time this form was prepared. Use the current date/time provided in the context.

3 INCIDENT NAME.label: 1. Incident Name
3 INCIDENT NAME.guidance: Short incident name, max ~35 characters: address or landmark plus incident type.

Date from.label: 2. Operational Period — Date From
Date from.guidance: Start date of this operational period (current date if the transcript gives no other).

Date to.label: 2. Operational Period — Date To
Date to.guidance: End date of this operational period. Leave blank if not established.

Time from.label: 2. Operational Period — Time From
Time from.guidance: Start time (24h) of this operational period.

Time to.label: 2. Operational Period — Time To
Time to.guidance: End time (24h). Leave blank if not established.

3. SAFETY MESSAGE.label: 3. Safety Message / Safety Plan / Site Safety Plan
3. SAFETY MESSAGE.guidance: The safety message for all personnel: enumerate the scene's hazards (red/unsafe conditions first), the protective measures in effect (PPE, accountability, collapse zones, utility control), and any expanded safety-plan direction. Ground every hazard in the scene conditions; standard fire-service safety doctrine may fill gaps.

Yes.label: 4. Site Safety Plan Required — Yes
Yes.guidance: Check when a site safety plan is required (hazmat, collapse risk, or any red/unsafe scene condition). Exactly one of Yes/No should be checked.

No.label: 4. Site Safety Plan Required — No
No.guidance: Check when no site safety plan is required. Exactly one of Yes/No should be checked.

Approved Site Safety Plan(s) Located At:.label: 4a. Approved Site Safety Plan(s) Located At
Approved Site Safety Plan(s) Located At:.guidance: Location of approved site safety plan documents. Fill only if stated; otherwise leave blank.

PREPARED BY (Name and Position).guidance: ICS position of the preparer (normally 'Safety Officer'); include a personal name only if explicitly stated in the evidence.

Date/Time:.label: 5. Date Prepared
Date/Time:.guidance: Date this form was prepared — use the current date provided in the context.

Text15.label: 5. Time Prepared

5 Incident AreaRow1.label: 4. Incident Area (Row 1)
5 Incident AreaRow1.guidance: Operational area/zone this row analyzes, e.g. 'Interior — main structure', 'Roof', 'Exposure Bravo'. Fill rows top-down, one row per distinct area with hazards; leave unused rows blank.

6 HazardsRisksRow1.label: 5. Hazards/Risks (Row 1)
6 HazardsRisksRow1.guidance: The hazards/risks present in that area, drawn from the scene conditions (red/unsafe items first, then yellow).

7 MitigationsRow1.label: 6. Mitigations (Row 1)
7 MitigationsRow1.guidance: Control measures for those hazards per standard fire-service practice (PPE, exclusion zones, ventilation, utility control, RIT, etc.).

4. NAME.guidance: Personal name of the individual maintaining this log - fill only if explicitly stated; never invent.

5. ICS POSITION.label: 5. ICS Position
5. ICS POSITION.guidance: Leave blank - the system stamps the owning role's position on this field.

Text56.label: 6. Operational Period - Date From (page 1)
Text56.guidance: Start date of this operational period.

Text57.label: 6. Operational Period - Date To (page 1)
Text57.guidance: End date. Leave blank if not established.

Text20.guidance: End time (24h). Leave blank if not established.

9. PREPARED BY (Name and Position).label: 9. Prepared By - Name and Position
9. PREPARED BY (Name and Position).guidance: ICS position of the log keeper; include a personal name only if explicitly stated.

NameRow1.label: 7. Personnel Assigned - Name (Row 1)
NameRow1.guidance: Personnel names - only those explicitly stated in the evidence (crew/unit staffing). Leave unused rows blank.

ICS PositionRow1.label: 7. Personnel Assigned - ICS Position (Row 1)
ICS PositionRow1.guidance: That person's ICS position/assignment, if stated.

Home BaseRow1.label: 7. Personnel Assigned - Home Base (Row 1)
Home BaseRow1.guidance: That person's home base/station, if stated.

TimeRow1.label: 8. Activity Log - Time (Row 1)
TimeRow1.guidance: Chronological major-events log from the transcript, earliest first, one event per row. Time in 24h; leave blank when the time is not stated or inferable.

Major EventsRow1.label: 8. Activity Log - Major Event (Row 1)
Major EventsRow1.guidance: The event/action for that time: dispatches, arrivals, assignments, condition changes, command decisions. Concise radio-log register.

5. SITUATION SUMMARY AND SAFETY BRIEFING.label: 5. Situation Summary and Safety Briefing
5. SITUATION SUMMARY AND SAFETY BRIEFING.guidance: The incident briefing: what is happening, where, the hazards to responder and public safety, and the safety briefing points. Ground it in the scene summary and conditions; red/unsafe items lead.

6. PREPARED BY Name and Position.label: 6. Prepared By - Name and Position (page 1)
6. PREPARED BY Name and Position.guidance: ICS position of the preparer (normally the initial Incident Commander / Fire Officer); personal name only if explicitly stated.

7. CURRENT AND PLANNED OBJECTIVES.label: 7. Current and Planned Objectives
7. CURRENT AND PLANNED OBJECTIVES.guidance: Numbered objectives ordered life safety, incident stabilization, property conservation - grounded in the scene conditions.

9. CURRENT ORGANIZATION.label: 9. Current Organization
9. CURRENT ORGANIZATION.guidance: Text outline of the current ICS organization: Incident Commander and any assigned positions/units the evidence states (e.g. 'IC: Fire Officer; Ops: Engine 3 crew'). Leave blank if no organization is evident.

Time Row 1.label: 8. Current/Planned Actions - Time (Row 1)
Time Row 1.guidance: Chronological actions taken or planned, earliest first, one per row. Time 24h; leave blank if not stated.

Action Row 1.label: 8. Current/Planned Actions - Action (Row 1)
Action Row 1.guidance: The action for that time: attack lines, search, ventilation, exposures, utilities, requests for resources.

Resources OrderedRow1.label: 10. Resource Summary - Resources Ordered (Row 1)
Resources OrderedRow1.guidance: Resource type ordered/assigned (e.g. 'Engine company', 'Ladder', 'EMS unit', 'Mutual aid tanker'). One resource per row from the evidence.

Resource IdentificationRow1.label: 10. Resource Summary - Identification (Row 1)
Resource IdentificationRow1.guidance: Unit designator if stated (e.g. 'Engine 3'). Never invent designators.

On SceneRow1.label: 10. Resource Summary - On Scene (Row 1)
On SceneRow1.guidance: 'Yes' when the resource is on scene per the evidence.

LocationAssignmentRow1.label: 10. Resource Summary - Location/Assignment (Row 1)
LocationAssignmentRow1.guidance: Where the resource is located / what it is assigned to (e.g. Side Alpha attack, staging, water supply).
